dialogues.speaker: Stone Gate Bulletin Board
dialogues.text: This is the Stone Gate Bulletin Board. You can find notices and messages from passersby posted here.

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Pops Zhou welcomes all travelers to come by and relax with a big cup of cheap, refreshing tea!"

dialogues.speaker: Another Note
dialogues.text: "Having known Pops Zhou for 40 years, I can vouch that his tea hasn't declined in quality one bit... though it hasn't improved either."
